implementation.coefficientReplay: Adaptive420/422 may retain exact quantized signed16-bit coefficients after the histogram pass and replay their original component/block order after Huffman construction. This removes the second normalization, conversion, transform and quantization.
implementation.admission: Exact-size owned capacity is reserved before allocation, capped at4MiB and selected using checked geometry and declared local remaining space including the conservative simultaneous table peak. No shared-root availability snapshot. Tight local limits select recomputation before admission; a shared refusal is terminal, with no retry, wait or lower-memory fallback.
implementation.ownership: Governed arrays remain private to the operation and release on completion/failure/cancellation. Ungoverned calls may reuse the existing bounded pool. No new global pool or growth/replacement overlap. Borrowed source/root and independently surviving output remain unchanged.
implementation.cost: Both controls require430848B coefficient capacity while encoding; warm pooled allocations remain372808B/op. Calls with a caller memory root allocate this private capacity instead of pooling; their timing/allocation measurement is open. Fixed8-KiB workspace and existing table owners remain separately admitted.
implementation.work: Same logical coarse MCU charges and per-entropy-write work/cancellation. Tests compare cached/recomputed actual charged work. Fixed-table/restart,444 and grayscale pipelines are unchanged.

qualification.newControlScope: 420/422 cached versus tight-workspace complete packets, exact charged work, independently observed simultaneous owner peak, unchanged source, aggregate shared refusal without retry, cancellation at coefficient admission, cleanup and subsequent success. Existing frozen packets, output failures and async/root ownership controls all rerun.
qualification.unchangedArithmeticScalarSimdEvidenceReu: E129/E135 exact word/byte normalization, forward transforms and quantization; no redundant arithmetic retuning or unrelated scalar audit.

strategyDecision: Reference insight identified duplicate whole-stage work. Independent entropy syntax replay proves compact events feasible. Fixed coefficients use430848B versus the event worst bound863940B on these controls and reuse an existing maintainable owner, so one coefficient primitive was selected. No upstream code/layout/tables incorporated.
evidenceReuse: Adaptive color420/422 CPU evidence for image8/16 and callerRGB changes; the current8-bit cost is screened without retuning or a second independent claim. Unchanged444, grayscale, fixed-table restarts, all decoders/other codecs/editing/text retain their relevant confirmations. No input/settings/grid expansion. The RGBA16 short/confirm use the identical immutable core; only final coherent production receives full qualification.

storage.scope: Redundant extracted package DLLs and duplicate feeds in completed generated consumers only; retained generated sources, consumer executables, logs, actual package and mirrored raw master. No archive of derivable duplicates.
